body:
The app died on its first frame with:

    java.lang.IllegalStateException: Expected an activity context for creating a
    HiltViewModelFactory but instead found: android.app.ContextImpl

Introduced by T-111. `LocalizedContent` overrides `LocalContext` so that
`stringResource` resolves in the chosen UI language, and it built that context
with `base.createConfigurationContext(configuration)`.

`createConfigurationContext` returns a bare `ContextImpl`, which is NOT a
`ContextWrapper`, so it has no `getBaseContext()`. Anything that walks up the
context chain looking for the Activity therefore dead-ends at it. `hiltViewModel()`
does exactly that walk. Because `LocalizedContent` wraps the whole app, EVERY
screen's `viewModel: X = hiltViewModel()` default parameter blew up — so the crash
was not screen-specific, it was "the app cannot start".

Why the existing tests did not catch it: the Compose UI tests pass their view
models in explicitly (that is what the T-127 fix did), so no test ever exercised
the `hiltViewModel()` default underneath `LocalizedContent`. The unit tests for
the locale layer only asserted that strings resolved in the right language, which
`createConfigurationContext` does correctly — the localization worked, only the
context chain was broken.

Fix: build the context as `ContextThemeWrapper(base, 0)` +
`applyOverrideConfiguration(configuration)`. A `ContextThemeWrapper` IS a
`ContextWrapper`, so `base` stays reachable and the walk still finds the Activity,
while the override configuration supplies the localized resources.

Regression test: `LocalizedContextTest` asserts the returned context unwraps to
the Activity via the same `findActivity` walk HiltViewModelFactory performs, that
German and Arabic strings still resolve, and that an application context (the
notification poster's caller) is still accepted. Confirmed the test FAILS against
the old `createConfigurationContext` implementation before being kept.

Shipped in the v1.9.0 build, which was retagged rather than released.
title: Android: app crashes on launch — LocalizedContent hid the Activity from hiltViewModel()
